title: Campbell Historical Museum

services.name: Admission
services.desc: Discover how 29 local artists (15 adult, 14 youth) visually define the concept of home. From physical sanctuaries to internal states of mind, this free exhibit at the Ainsley House offers a beautiful look at what connects us. Vote for your favorite adult and youth artwork during your visit. The winning pieces will be turned into temporary public art! Visit the lobby of Campbell's new police station to view our exhibit that highlights tools of the trade used by Campbell Police Department since its formation in 1952. services.name: Walking Tours
services.desc: The Campbell Museums' mission is to interpret and preserve the history of the Campbell area from its early beginnings to today and to relate that history within the context of the Santa Clara Valley region. The Campbell Museums are owned and operated by the City of Campbell. For any questions, concerns, requests, or inquiries related to museum operations, please contact museum staff directly. The Campbell Museum Foundation is a nonprofit organization dedicated to supporting the Museums through fundraising and advocacy
